title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Payment Clearing What Is Owed on a Demand Service Account
content:
## The request this covers

An owner holding a rate program under the Demand Service Rate Programs may ask to settle the demand
service account, paying money off the account so that what is owed on it is cleared.

The figure that clears the demand service account is settled only once the call last completed on the program carries its labor charge on the ledger. The figure that clears the demand service account is settled only after the late fee the billing month owes stands as a line on the rate program. The figure that clears the demand service account is settled only after the credit owed for the missed response on the call last completed on the program stands as a credit entry on the rate program.

A charge line raised on the program during the billing month stands without a due day until the billing
month's invoice is issued, and until then it has not fallen due.

## The effect on the account

One payment entry is opened on the rate program, carrying the money amount paid, how it was paid and the
day the office received it, and that amount comes off what is owed on the demand service account
straight away.

## Who runs it

This is the building owner's own act. The tool `record_account_payment_d97a44a1` is unlocked and handed
over, and the customer themselves runs it; the desk states the rate program reference when handing it
over and works out the figure that clears the account from the published terms and the records.

## The parameters

- `program_id` — the reference number of the demand service rate program the money is paid against, as
  the desk states it when handing this over.
- `payment_amount_usd` — the money amount paid, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the cent
  and never negative.
- `payment_method` — how the money is paid, one of exactly four values: `check`, a paper cheque being
  sent or handed to the office; `ach`, the money pushed from the owner's bank account by direct debit or
  bank transfer through the clearing system; `credit_card`, a company credit or debit card charged on
  the spot; and `wire`, the money sent as a same-day bank wire.

## The receipt

One line of plain text comes back naming the reference number of the new payment entry, the amount paid
in USD to 2 decimal places and the way it was paid. The named payment entry reference is the receipt
that the money was taken.
